title: EduToolV3 — Knowledge Graph
description: Graphify knowledge book for the EduToolV3 repository: high-level concepts and navigation for the backend (NestJS, Prisma/PostgreSQL) and frontend (React/Next.js) portals, their features, and relationships across the codebase.

Student-Enrollment.description: Student acquisition and enrollment: class enrollment, program enrollment, org enrollment settings, subject prerequisites, and eligibility checks

JWT-Authentication.description: JWT-based authentication with access/refresh token rotation, Passport strategy, and guards

AI-Question-Generation.description: AI-powered assessment question generation with concept extraction, chunking, progress tracking, and preview workflows

Grading-Scheme-Templates.description: Reusable grading scheme templates: program/class assignment, auto-apply to new classes, and per-program component weight resolution

Real-Time-Meeting.description: Real-time video conferencing with WebRTC (Agora), WebSocket signaling, chat, reactions, screen sharing, and presentation sync

Assessment-Hybrid-Grading.description: Hybrid assessment grading mode combining auto-graded system questions with manually graded sections

Organization-Seeding.description: Bulk organization bootstrap data: programs, grading schemes/scales/templates, levels, sections, strands, subjects, prerequisites, and semester templates seeded for a new organization

Prisma-Data-Access.description: Database access layer using Prisma ORM with DatabaseService singleton and repository pattern across all modules

Grade-Computation-Engine.description: Weighted grade computation with category breakdowns, hybrid score merging, grading scale resolution, and lock management

Role-Based-Access-Control.description: RBAC system with role guards, decorators, and multi-portal authorization (admin, educator, student, platform)

Academic-Organization.description: Academic program structure: programs, strands, levels, sections, subjects, and courses with school-year association and cross-org sharing

Analytics-Dashboard.description: Analytics and dashboards: enrollment breakdown, grade analytics, educator load, academic context, and actionable alerts

Academic-Calendar.description: Academic calendar management: school years, semesters, semester templates with term dates, and academic-calendar holidays and breaks

Multi-Tenant-Organization.description: Multi-tenant architecture where each organization has isolated data scoped by org_id throughout all queries

Scheduled-Background-Jobs.description: Cron-based background jobs for auto grade-lock, submission cleanup, notification archiving, and enrollment management

edges.description: Main process bootstraps the root AppModule

configuration.description: Application configuration loaded from environment variables with Joi validation

course.description: Course management: CRUD with program and school year associations

validation.description: Request validation using class-validator pipes and custom validators

transcript.description: Student transcripts: transcript generation and student-view endpoints

mail.description: Email delivery: OTP and credentials emails via nodemailer

frontend-hooks.description: Frontend React hooks for data fetching, state management, and real-time features

subject.description: Subject management: CRUD, versioning, sharing across organizations, and lock/unlock

meeting.description: Video conferencing: Agora RTC integration, WebSocket gateway for real-time features, meeting CRUD, and join requests

grading-scheme.description: Grading scheme management: component weight configuration, template application, and class assignment

notification.description: Notification system: create, list, mark read, and archive notifications for users

grading-scale.description: Grading scale management: letter grade ranges, program assignment, and percentage-to-grade resolution

ai.description: AI-powered content generation: concept extraction, concept building, and question generation via OpenRouter API

semester-template.description: Semester templates: reusable term-date patterns, program assignment, and placeholder semester generation

upload.description: File upload: profile images and organization logos with path persistence

org-seeder.description: Organization bootstrap seeder: programs, strands, levels, sections, subjects, courses, grading data, prerequisites, and semester templates

enrollment.description: Student enrollment: class enrollment, prerequisite checking, capacity management, and eligibility validation

frontend-context.description: Frontend React context providers for auth, sidebar, and meeting state

grade.description: Grade computation: weighted scoring, category breakdowns, manual scores, grading scale resolution, and grade publishing

audit-log.description: Audit logging for admin actions and educator activity events with searchable history

org-enrollment-setting.description: Organization enrollment settings governing how students enroll into classes and programs

academic-calendar.description: Academic calendar management: holidays, breaks, program calendars, and term date assignment

authentication.description: Authentication system: JWT-based auth with Passport, login, register, OTP, token refresh, and guards

frontend-pages.description: Frontend Next.js App Router pages for admin, educator, student, and platform portals

organization.description: Organization management: CRUD, settings, and multi-tenant configuration

lesson.description: Lesson management: CRUD, AI concept extraction/building, week structure generation, and student lesson viewing

grading-scheme-template.description: Reusable grading scheme templates: program/class assignment, auto-apply to new classes, and component weight resolution

platform.description: Platform administration: super admin management, platform-level configuration, and school oversight

program.description: Program management: curriculum programs with type resolver, strand/section/level association, and semester linking

analytics.description: Analytics: enrollment breakdown, grade analytics, educator load, and actionable alerts

scheduler.description: Scheduled background tasks: auto grade-lock, draft cleanup, notification archiving, and auto-unenrollment

core-infrastructure.description: Core application infrastructure: bootstrap, configuration, middleware, interceptors, pipes, and global exception filters

presentation.description: Presentation slides: CRUD, per-lesson slides, and AI slide generation

assessment.description: Assessment system: create, manage, and grade assessments with AI question generation, hybrid grading, and score publishing

frontend-styles.description: Frontend CSS stylesheets and theme definitions

grade-lock.description: Grade locking system: settings, auto-lock, unlock requests, override, and deadline management

section.description: Section management: CRUD and student counting within a section

subject-prerequisite.description: Subject prerequisite management: required prior subjects, bulk creation, and eligibility checking

frontend-api.description: Frontend API layer: HTTP client and API function modules for all portals

error-handling.description: Global exception filters for structured error responses

submission.description: Assessment submissions: start/resume, drafts, finishing, answer retrieval, and expired-draft cleanup

frontend-components.description: Frontend React components: shared UI, admin, educator, student, meeting, and landing

semester.description: Semester management: CRUD scoped to a school year with active semester resolution

strand.description: Strand management: CRUD for academic strands within a program

student-enrollment.description: Student acquisition and enrollment: class and program enrollment, bulk enrollment, and unenrollment

attendance.description: Attendance tracking: session generation from class schedules, bulk recording, and student/educator views

authorization.description: Role-based access control with @Roles() decorator and RolesGuard

school-year.description: School year management: CRUD, active-school-year resolution, activation, and end-of-year handling

export.description: Export utilities: class card PDF generation and class CSV export

logging.description: Structured logging with Winston, request logging interceptor, and request ID tracing

level.description: Level management: default levels, per-program/strand/course levels, and next-level generation

database.description: SQLite/PostgreSQL database access via Prisma ORM with global DatabaseService provider

frontend-store.description: Frontend Zustand state stores for auth, meeting, and notifications

class.description: Class management: CRUD, scheduling, enrollment, educator assignment, and ownership tracking

student.description: Student management: CRUD, profile management, enrollment history, and status management

health.description: Health check endpoint for service readiness
